sources.entry: Stringed 2 - Music practice software designed to help users learn how to play their favorite songs.

summary.name: Stringed 2
summary.one_liner: Stringed 2 is a Mac music practice app for slowing down, speeding up, pitch-shifting, looping and exporting audio so users can learn songs.
keywords: speed up audio without pitch change
use_cases: Learning fast guitar or bass solos by slowing them down
Practicing along in a different key by shifting pitch
Looping difficult sections to repeat them
Isolating an instrument with the balance slider
Exporting adjusted tracks to play elsewhere
summary.what_it_does: Stringed 2 plays audio files and lets users change tempo from 1/4 of the original speed up to 1.75x without changing pitch. It shifts pitch up or down by up to 12 semitones. Users can select a region and loop it, and an equalizer with a balance slider is provided to emphasize one instrument. Adjusted tracks can be exported. Supported input formats named are aiff, wav, mp4 and mp3.
notable: Independent tempo and pitch control, up to 12 semitones and 1/4x to 1.75x speed
Region looping with a single loop toggle
Export of pitch- and tempo-adjusted audio
Reviewers cite a price around $5 and compare it to Capo and Amazing Slowdowner
caveats: Reviewer notes it does not save per-track settings or loop positions the way Capo did
Page does not state a current price; reviewers mention about $5 for upgrade context
Not enough ratings or reviews to show an overview yet
Reviewer says version was built around Yosemite-era compatibility; current OS support not confirmed on the page
